beforeTokenTransfer(address,address,addr.notice: Rewards already earned stay with their owner across balance         changes: each side's debt is re-based so that         `accrued(after) - debt(after)` equals their pending before the         transfer. Only the accrual attributable to the transferred         tokens changes hands, so transfers can no longer burn pending         rewards that a holder has already earned.
